zh.doc_title: 免费电子书下载：易学基础 · 风水实务 · 八字命理 · 辨伪与化解
zh.sub: 四卷 · PDF · 免费下载，不用注册
intro: 四卷电子书，免费下载，不用注册，也不用留邮箱。它们是把站上已经公开的文章按门类重新编排成的 PDF：加了封面、目录和页码，删掉了每篇文末的推广与联系方式，正文一字未改。
四卷合计一百一十九篇，从易学基础，到风水实务、八字命理，再到辨伪、预测理论与化解。每卷可以单独读；按顺序读，是一条「先弄清词，再去看地，再去读盘，最后问它凭什么站得住」的线。手机、平板、电脑都能直接打开，A5 版面，字号按阅读而非打印设置。
note: 格式为 PDF（A5 开本），保留了可点击的目录和书签：在阅读器里打开大纲栏，可以直接跳到任意一篇。
免费下载、欢迎转发，请保留出处，请勿用于售卖。每篇文字及其英文译文，仍可在站上逐篇阅读；英文四卷收录的是对应文章的人工译本。
文中观点是作者的一家之言，靠案例立论，不靠权威立论。读者不必先信，也不必先不信——可以先看它说的东西，能不能对上你能去现场看到的那个样子。

en.doc_title: Free ebooks: Foundations of Yixue, Feng Shui Practice, Bazi, and the Method
en.sub: Four volumes · PDF · free, no sign-up
intro: Four volumes, free to download. No account, no email address. Each is a PDF assembled from essays already published on this site: cover, contents and page numbers added, the sales copy and contact details that trail the Chinese originals removed, the arguments left exactly as they were.

Together they run to 119 essays — the vocabulary layer, feng shui in practice, the four pillars, and the volume on evidence, prediction theory and remedy. Each stands alone. Read in order, they follow one line: learn the words, then look at ground, then read a chart, then ask what any of it is entitled to claim.
A5 pages, set for reading rather than printing, with a clickable table of contents and PDF bookmarks. The Chinese shelf holds the original essays; the English shelf is the translation.
note: Every volume has a clickable contents page and a PDF outline — open the sidebar in your reader and jump straight to any essay.
Free to download and pass on. Please keep the source and credit it; do not sell it. Every essay is also readable individually on this site, in English and in the Chinese original.
What you will find inside is a position argued from cases, not a finding. No reader is asked to accept it on authority — only to check it against something that can be gone and looked at.

zh.title: 易学基础
zh.sub: 阴阳、五行、干支是怎么建起来的
zh.desc: 二十四篇。把其他门类都要借用的那套词先拆开：阴阳不是两种东西，五行不是五种材料，干支也不是记号——弄清它们各自在做什么，后面才谈得上用。

zh.title: 风水实务
zh.sub: 从寻龙点穴到城市住宅
zh.desc: 四十四篇，篇幅最大的一卷。从寻龙、点穴、看砂水、立向这些老工序，一路讲到今天的户型、写字楼和街巷；最后几篇讲这套东西做不到什么。

zh.title: 八字命理
zh.sub: 读盘、取用与断验的边界
zh.desc: 十八篇。日主怎么定旺衰，用神怎么取，一个盘从哪里读起，以及读到哪一步就该停手——不把推断说成事实。

zh.title: 辨伪 · 理论 · 化解
zh.desc: 三十三篇。先在真个案上看法子怎么跑，再看它对「预测」这件事允许断言什么，最后看断言之后还能做什么——以及做到哪一层为止。

en.title: Foundations of Yixue
en.sub: Yin and yang, the five phases, the stems and the branches
en.desc: Twenty-four essays that take apart the terms every other branch of Chinese metaphysics borrows — and show what each one is doing before anyone starts using it.

en.title: Practising Feng Shui
en.sub: Reading a house, a site, and a grave
en.desc: Forty-four essays moving from the classical procedure — finding the dragon, fixing the seat, judging sand and water, taking the orientation — to the rooms and streets people actually live in.

en.title: Reading the Four Pillars
en.sub: Bazi: the method, the cases, and the limits
en.desc: Eighteen essays on the chart itself: how a day master is judged, how the useful god is chosen, and where the reading stops being an argument and starts being a guess.

en.title: Testing the Claim
en.sub: Evidence, prediction theory, and the work of remedy
en.desc: Thirty-three essays on the question a reader eventually asks: is any of this checkable? What a prediction claims, how a case is judged, and what an adjustment is supposed to change.
